name: Davis Conservation Foundation grants
summary: Twice-yearly, normally one-year grants to 501(c)(3) charities working on wildlife, wildlife habitat and environmental protection, with highest priority on Northern New England (the Northern Forest and Gulf of Maine) and a preference for projects involving volunteers and communities.
reporting: A completion report is due at the project's end date or within one year of receiving funds.
